7.t: Working with data: a species survey
q: Which habitat had the most species?
How many more species were in the forest than the park?
Suggest why the forest has the most biodiversity.
More kinds of food, shelter and nesting places: more niches.
A company wants to clear half the forest for a farm. Predict and explain the effect on birds.
Biodiversity would fall: species needing forest lose habitat; some may become locally extinct; food webs are disrupted.
